title: Review: I-D alignment, idempotent Peer/deliver, chat ULID IDs
notes:
Maintainer risk: HIGH — Two P0 security/correctness bugs (receipt auth bypass, idempotency error swallow) plus three P1 behavioral bugs (ordering, outbox, group chat rejection) that will generate user reports immediately. The RFC 8620 violation will cause client-side state divergence that is hard to diagnose.
Confidence: 25% chance of missed bug. Uncertainty driven by: (1) could not run the test suite to confirm test failures, (2) kith-peer/src/lib.rs is large and the outbox integration path through Message/set → enqueue → retry loop was only spot-checked, not fully traced. (3) Schema migration correctness for V3→V4 with real data was verified by code inspection only, not by running the migration. Would raise confidence if: tests run green, and a retransmit integration test is added (P1-6).
